name: Hallmark
problem: If you build websites with an AI coding tool, you get the same generic page every time, whatever the business.
The result is instantly recognisable as AI-made: same layouts, same gradients, same filler.
idea: Write [[habits|each AI-design habit]] as [[rule|a numbered rule]] that code can check, and make the finished page pass every rule before you see it.

children.name: SKILL.md
overview: Start here: the agent reads this first on every build
The Floor: the never-break rules, summarised
Flow: the 7 numbered stages, pre-flight to final check
Commands: <prompt>, redesign, audit
Variants: single components, app screens, a quick mode

children.name: gates.md
overview: §1 How strict each rule is, and how results are graded
§2 How to break a Reflex rule on the record
§3 The agent's self-score before the final check
§4 The 87 rules in 6 areas: number, tier, tell, fix
§5 Craft checks that never block
§6 How the fresh reviews run

children.name: themes/
overview: Theme: a visual material (palette, fonts, surfaces). Never the layout.
50 × <name>.md, ≤8 KB each
Sections: Tokens, Type, Surfaces, Range, Controls, Motion, Voice, Do-nots, Build hint
50 × <name>.jpg: a finished page in that theme
index.json: keywords + genre used for dealing

children.name: anatomy.md
overview: Anatomy: how real sites for each job are built
One section per job: subscribe, book, visit, attend, buy, try, sign up, hire, join, listen
Each: where the action sits, which sections real sites have
How pages end

children.name: macrostructures/
overview: Macrostructure: a page's overall shape
One file per shape: Bento Grid, Letter, Workbench…
Each: rules for heading, body, divider, button, image, reveal
When to use, when to avoid, sample opening lines

children.name: review-hero.md
overview: Hero: the first screen of a page
Prompt for the fresh reviewer: an AI with no memory of the build
First word: ship or fix
Up to 5 findings, from 6 checklist questions

children.name: review-finish.md
overview: Prompt for the fresh reviewer of the whole page
First word: ship, fix, rebuild, or retake the screenshots
Up to 8 findings, ranked by cost
Final check: does the page match its stated idea?

children.name: sloplint.mjs
overview: sloplint: Hallmark's checker. Reports every broken rule
One check per machine-checkable gate
Reads HTML, CSS, JSX, Vue, Svelte
Flags: --render, --genre, --scope, --stage
Output: FAIL / REFLEX / WARN with file:line and fix

children.name: sloplint-render.mjs
overview: Opens the page in Chrome (puppeteer)
Checks that need the real screen: overflow, fold, sizes
Saves screenshots for the reviewers

children.name: theme.mjs
overview: deal: 3 themes from keywords + genre + log
draw: page shape, hero, nav, footer
scaffold: writes tokens.css + base.css
photos: picks library photos by subject
log: records the build

children.name: photos.json
overview: 755 Wikimedia Commons photos
Each: link, page, author, licence
Links only, no image files

phases.title: Understand
phases.overview: Reads your project, asks once for real [[material]].

phases.title: Decide
phases.overview: Scripts [[deal|deal a theme]] and [[draw|draw a structure]]; the agent picks and shows its plan.

phases.title: Build
phases.overview: Starter files, then the hero first, checked and reviewed before the rest.

phases.title: Verify
phases.overview: Full check at 8 widths until clean, then a fresh final review.

steps.title: Ask for a page
steps.detail: e.g. /hallmark a booking page for my clinic

steps.title: Pre-flight
steps.detail: Reads your project: fonts, colours, framework, design.md.

steps.title: Ask 4 questions
steps.detail: Material, audience, use, tone. Reply “go ahead” to skip.

steps.title: Name the job
steps.detail: The job is what a visitor comes to do: book, buy, subscribe… It decides where the main button goes and how the page ends.

steps.title: deal
steps.detail: Scores 50 themes on your words, skips recent ones, returns 3.

steps.title: Pick theme
steps.detail: Looks at the 3 theme pictures, picks one.

steps.title: draw
steps.detail: Randomly deals page shape, hero, nav, footer.

steps.title: Picks block
steps.detail: Shows every decision once. Your chance to redirect.

steps.title: Build hero
steps.detail: First screen only: ≤7-word headline, 1 sentence, 1–2 buttons.

steps.title: sloplint (hero)
steps.detail: Checks the hero at 375 and 1280 px.

steps.title: Hero review
steps.detail: Sees only screenshots. Verdict: ship, fix, rebuild.

steps.title: Finish review
steps.detail: Fresh look at the whole page. Final verdict.

steps.title: Get the page
steps.detail: HTML/CSS, check results, and a list of photo slots: placeholders where your own photos replace library stand-ins.

why: **Checkable, not vibes:** each tell is a numbered rule with a fix.
**Code, not opinion:** sloplint tests the rendered page at 8 widths. A pass can't be faked.
**Forced variety:** deal and draw skip recent builds, so pages don't converge.
**Strict where it matters:** Floor rules never bend; Reflex rules bend only with a written reason.
**Unbiased review:** the final reviewer never saw the build.
**No invented proof:** no fake metrics, logos or testimonials.

use.agentPrompt:
Install the Hallmark design skill (github.com/Nutlope/hallmark) on this computer. Explain each step in one plain sentence. Ask before installing anything not listed.

1. Check Node.js is 18 or newer (node -v). If not, help me install it.
2. Run: npx skills add nutlope/hallmark -g --agent claude-code
3. Optional, for the browser checks: npm i -g puppeteer-core, and confirm Google Chrome is installed.
4. Confirm the install worked: when I type / in Claude Code, /hallmark should appear. If it doesn't, tell me to restart Claude Code.

envs.name: Claude Code
commands: Save the look to design.md, so later pages match

envs.name: Terminal
commands: Install for every agent and project (once)

habits.title: 87 habits it bans
habits.body: Each is a tell: a visible sign a page is AI-made. **Floor**: never allowed. **Reflex**: allowed with a written reason.

items.text: Purple-to-blue, purple-to-pink or cyan-on-dark gradient anywhere, background-clip: text included
Gradient text in any other hue
Inter, Roboto, Open Sans, Poppins, Lato or a system face as the display
One italic word inside an otherwise roman heading
Card tells: three equal columns of icon-above-heading tiles, an icon in a rounded tile above a heading, a…
Copy tells: placeholder names (Jane Doe), startup clichés (Acme, Nexus), buzzwords (seamless, robust,…
Chrome by reflex: the AI nav (wordmark left, inline links, button right, hairline under) or the AI footer…
transition: all; animating width, height, top or left
An emoji standing in for an icon
Two icon libraries on one page

rule.title: Gate: one numbered rule
rule.body: Each names one tell, its fix, its tier and who checks it. Example:
kv: The eyebrow: a small label before a heading that announces it, e.g. TRUSTED BY over logos
Figure captions, table heads, form labels, nav or tab labels, bylines, dates
Delete the label, or make it the heading

material.title: Material
material.body: Real things the page can show: your photos, screenshots, numbers, quotes. Never invented.

deal.title: Deal
deal.body: theme.mjs scores 50 themes on your words and genre, skips recently used ones, offers 3.

draw.title: Draw
draw.body: theme.mjs randomly picks the page shape, hero, nav and footer, avoiding recent builds.
